summary: Windows 1.0.66: PROGRAM echoed+ACK, 0x02 returned 1-byte echo + 8-byte ident, then 'Radio identification failed'. The ident bytes are not in the trace (pre-1.0.68). OEM CPS read handshake accepts any 8 bytes (RX VA x8) and identifies the model by byte 0x1F05 (5A/79/A5 per band version); the ident is the image's 0x1F00-0x1F07 block, so byte 5 is that model byte.
title: Download refuses an RA87 whose 8-byte ident differs from the two captured fingerprints
